title: Nine Inches at Three Hundred Yards
subtitle: 目标与目的 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 目标与目的（做人与做事·目标与目的）
meta: 主题语境：目标与目的（做人与做事·目标与目的）　|　核心词汇：aim　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 aim 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 my uncle had one ① aim, which was to hit a mark nine inches across at three hundred yards, and he did it nine times and then stopped. He said an aim is the only thing you can have that is not a wish, and he said the difference is that a wish does not tell you where to stand; an aim, he said, is a wish with numbers on it.

He ② took aim for the last time in 1958 and put the rifle down and never picked it up, and nobody in the family has ever asked why. There was ③ no aim in the eleven years after that, by which my grandmother meant no plan, and she said a man without an aim is not the same as a man with a bad one; aim, she said, is the cheapest thing a person can have.

In 1969 he began to build a boat ④ with the aim of finishing it in three years, and it took him eleven and he never launched it. My father said he would never ⑤ achieve his aim, and my grandmother said ⑥ an aim you do not reach is the only kind that keeps you going, and she was right about that and wrong about nothing else.

The boat was ⑦ aimed at the sea and had never been in it, and he said the phrase is what people use when they do not want to say where. He did not ⑧ aim to hurt anybody, he said in 1981, and nobody had said he had, which my mother said was the whole of the trouble; an aim, he said, is something you can miss for eleven years.

The ⑨ aim I would put on a card, if I had to write one down, is not the boat but the nine inches at three hundred yards, which he hit nine times and then stopped. An ⑩ aim, he told me in 1990, is the only possession you can lose without noticing, and the only one that does you any good once it is gone.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （射击等的）瞄准目标；靶子
D. 固定搭配：aim to do sth. 旨在做某事；打算做
E. 固定搭配：take aim (at ...) 瞄准（……）
F. 固定搭配：with the aim of ... 旨在；以……为目的
G. 固定搭配：achieve / realise one's aim 实现目标
H. 固定搭配：aim at ... 针对；旨在

items.q: one aim, which was to hit a mark
took aim for the last time
There was no aim in the eleven years

answers.why: aim 意为“目标、目的”，1952 年叔叔只有一个目标：在三百码外打中一个九英寸宽的靶子。
take aim 意为“瞄准”，1958 年他最后一次瞄准，然后放下枪，再没拿起来。
aim 意为“目标、目的”，之后的十一年里他没有任何目标，祖母的意思是没有任何计划。
with the aim of ... 意为“旨在、以……为目的”，1969 年他开始造船，打算三年完工。
achieve one's aim 意为“实现目标”，父亲说他永远实现不了自己的目标。
aim 意为“志向、追求”，祖母说实现不了的志向才是让人一直走下去的那种。
aim at ... 意为“针对、旨在”，那条船 aimed at 大海，却从未下过水。
aim to do sth. 意为“旨在做、打算做”，1981 年他说他并不想伤害任何人。
aim 意为“瞄准目标、靶子”，我要写在卡片上的是那三百码外九英寸宽的靶子，而不是那条船。
aim 意为“志向、追求”，他说志向是唯一一样你丢了也不会察觉的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年叔叔只有一个目标：在三百码外打中一个九英寸宽的靶子。（aim）
1958 年他最后一次瞄准，然后放下枪，再也没有拿起来。（take aim）
1969 年他开始造一条船，打算三年造完，结果造了十一年。（with the aim of）

他说那条船 aimed at 大海，却从未下过水。（aim at）
1981 年他说自己并不想伤害任何人，而并没有人说过他伤害过谁。（aim to）
answers: In 1952 my uncle had one aim, to hit a mark nine inches across at three hundred yards.
He took aim for the last time in 1958 and put the rifle down and never picked it up.
In 1969 he began to build a boat with the aim of finishing it in three years, and it took him eleven.
My father said he would never achieve his aim, and my grandmother said an aim you do not reach is the only kind that keeps you going.
The boat was aimed at the sea and had never been in it, he said.
He did not aim to hurt anybody, he said in 1981, and nobody had said he had.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 aim 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 my uncle had one aim, to hit a mark nine inches across at three hundred yards.
He took aim for the last time in 1958, and there was no aim in the eleven years after that.
In 1969 he began to build a boat with the aim of finishing it in three years.
My father said he would never achieve his aim, and my grandmother said an aim you do not reach keeps you going.
The boat was aimed at the sea and had never been in it, and he did not aim to hurt anybody.
